PT-02 prints the truss spacing as 1.33 (x 58) — the ticks are placed at exact thirds of the 4.00 bays (rounded to cm, e.g. 5.33 / 6.67 / 8.00), so consecutive positions differ by 1.33 or 1.34; the printed 1.33 is the rounded 1.333.

Two tick pairs within 0.05 m are kept as two lines, not merged (rule 4): y -2.20 vs -2.15 and 12.70 vs 12.65 — the PT-02 purlin plan prints its outer band as 2.15 while every other roof sheet (S-06, S-22, PT-02 truss plan, A-14) prints 2.20; it may be the same eave measured to a different edge.

Scaled dummies (no printed tick from any grid line): x -0.68 / 80.68 and y -0.30 / 0.80 — the pipe-duct boxes outside columns A1 / A21 (Gx/Gy on S-03, Bx on S-04 / S-05). The sheets dimension the box only from the column face (0.50) and along itself (1.10, 0.10); the lines were placed by proportion against the grid (outer line = 0.50 + half the 0.35 column C2) and every beam on them is flagged.

z axis: datum ระดับดินทั่วไป ±0.00 (A-05: ±0.00 is set by the owner on site, natural ground or the nearest road surface; fill to +0.30). The ground floor is +0.70 on every spot level (A-09 พื้น คสล. ผิวขัดมัน +0.70, A-14 section 2-2 +0.70) but the A-14 level chain prints 0.90 from ground to the ground floor — the spot level was taken (two prints beat one) and every higher level was derived from +0.70 plus the printed A-14 storey chain (4.20 / 3.50 / 3.50 and the stair chain 2.45 / 1.75 / 1.75 / 1.75 / 1.20 / 2.30, also printed on S-13 / S-14). If the 0.90 base is right, every level above the ground floor is 0.20 higher.

Level labels printed twice at different heights (ระดับพื้นชานพัก, ระดับพื้นระเบียง(ห้องโถง)) were given a parenthetical floor tag to keep the z ids unique; the verbatim label is quoted in each level note.
